title: Avane Srimannarayana
desc: Narayana attempts to solve the mystery behind the treasure that has gone missing. However, Jayaram, a gang leader, places several obstacles in his way.

title: Dhuruvangal Pathinaaru
desc: Deepak, a retired police officer, narrates an old murder case of his to his friend's son, explaining how he solved the crime.

title: 7aum Arivu
desc: Dong Lee from China arrives in India to start a biological war. However, a genetic engineering student tries to revive the skills of Bodhidharma with the help of his descendant to defeat Dong Lee.

title: Pokkiri Raja
desc: Raja takes the blame for a murder committed by his father and is deserted by him. Years later, his father comes seeking his help when his younger brother, Surya, is falsely imprisoned.
